# modelbuilder

**modelbuilder - A package for graphical building and analysis of
compartmental simulation models**

## Note

**The package has not seen much attention lately and was never fully
completed. It should mostly work, but there are no guarantees. Let me
know if something fails.**

## Description

This R package provides functionality that lets the user build and
analyze compartmental simulation models, implemented as ordinary
differential equations, stochastic equivalents, or discrete time models.
All model building and analysis can be done without writing code. The
user can export code for one of the model implementations for further
customization.

## Getting Started

I assume you have `R` installed. I also highly recommend to have an IDE
like `Positron` or `RStudio`, though it’s not required. The package has
not yet been submitted to CRAN, therefore it currently needs to be
installed from Github. To do so, you need the `remotes` package. If you
don’t have it, install it first. Then, install and get **modelbuilder**
up and running with these commands:

``` R
library('remotes') #install this package if you don't have it
install_github('andreashandel/modelbuilder')
library('modelbuilder')
modelbuilder()
```

Next, see the [Get Started
section](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/articles/modelbuilder.html)
for a basic and currently sparse - but hopefully still informative -
introduction.

## Further information

- We developed two packages that teach the use of compartmental
  simulation models for use on the population level ([DSAIDE
  package](https://andreashandel.github.io/DSAIDE/)), and individual
  host/patient level ([DSAIRM
  package](https://andreashandel.github.io/DSAIRM/)). Those packages
  come with pre-coded simulations and are meant for learning, while
  **modelbuilder** lets you build your own models and is geared towards
  more advanced users.
- I regularly teach courses related to infectious diseases and modeling.
  Materials covering population level infectious diseases and modeling
  [can be found here](https://andreashandel.github.io/IDEMAcourse/),
  similar materials covering modeling on the within-host, patient level
  [can be found here](https://andreashandel.github.io/SMIcourse/).
- Contributions to the package are very welcome! If you want to take a
  deeper look at the package, see [this Markdown
  file](https://github.com/andreashandel/modelbuilder/blob/master/auxiliary/docsfordevelopers/documentation.md)
  which provides further information on the details of the package
  structure. I’d be excited to receive any contributions from
  individuals who want to help improve the package. If you plan to make
  substantial contributions, it might be best to get in touch with me
  first.
- I send out a monthly newsletter in which (among other things) I
  announce any noteworthy updates to my R packages. If you want to stay
  updated, [you can sign up
  here](https://www.andreashandel.com/susbscribe/).

## Acknowledgements

This R package is developed and maintained by [Andreas
Handel](https://www.andreashandel.com/). A full list of contributors
[can be found
here](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/authors.html).

This project was/is partially supported by NIH grants U19AI117891, R01
GM124280 and GM 12480-03S1 and a grant from the University of Georgia’s
Center for Teaching and Learning.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_model_flow()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/add_model_flow.md)
  : A helper function that adds flow UI inputs to the shiny UI elements
  of the build tab
- [`add_model_par()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/add_model_par.md)
  : A helper function that adds a paramter to the shiny UI elements of
  the build tab
- [`add_model_var()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/add_model_var.md)
  : A helper function that adds a variable to the shiny UI elements of
  the build tab
- [`analyze_model()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/analyze_model.md)
  : Run simulations for a modelbuilder model object.
- [`check_model()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/check_model.md)
  : A function that takes a modelbuilder model and checks it for errors
- [`generate_buildUI()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_buildUI.md)
  : A helper function that takes a model and generates the shiny UI
  elements for the build tab
- [`generate_discrete()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_discrete.md)
  : Create a discrete time simulation model
- [`generate_equations()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_equations.md)
  : Turn a model into a set of differential equations displayed as
  LaTeX/HTML object
- [`generate_function_documentation()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_function_documentation.md)
  : Create documentation/header part for a simulation model
- [`generate_function_inputs()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_function_inputs.md)
  : Create function input/arguments part for a simulation model
- [`generate_ggplot()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_ggplot.md)
  : A helper function that takes simulation results and produces ggplot
  plots
- [`generate_model()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_model.md)
  : A helper function that reads the shiny model builder UI inputs and
  saves information in a model object
- [`generate_model_file()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_model_file.md)
  : Create code that encodes a modelbuilder model
- [`generate_ode()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_ode.md)
  : Create an ODE simulation model
- [`generate_plotly()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_plotly.md)
  : A helper function that takes simulation results and produces plotly
  plots
- [`generate_shinyinput()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_shinyinput.md)
  : A helper function that takes a model and generates shiny UI elements
- [`generate_stochastic()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_stochastic.md)
  : Create a stochastic compartmental simulation model
- [`generate_stratified_model()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_stratified_model.md)
  : Stratify an mb model by groups
- [`generate_stratifier_list()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_stratifier_list.md)
  : Produce a default stratifier list for use with the
  generate_stratification function
- [`generate_tables()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_tables.md)
  : Generate a table of state variables, parameters, and initial values
- [`generate_text()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/generate_text.md)
  : A helper function that takes result from the simulators and produces
  text output
- [`get_math()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/get_math.md)
  : Extract the math symbols from a flow
- [`get_vars_pars()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/get_vars_pars.md)
  : Extract the variables and parameters from a flow
- [`load_model()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/load_model.md)
  : A function that loads a model saved as file
- [`modelbuilder()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/modelbuilder.md)
  : Load the main menu for the modelbuilder package
- [`remove_model_flow()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/remove_model_flow.md)
  : A helper function that removes a the shiny UI elements for a flow of
  the build tab
- [`remove_model_par()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/remove_model_par.md)
  : A helper function that removes a parameter from the shiny UI
  elements of the build tab
- [`remove_model_var()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/remove_model_var.md)
  : A helper function that removes a variable to the shiny UI elements
  of the build tab
- [`remove_model_variableModal()`](https://andreashandel.github.io/modelbuilder/index.html/reference/remove_model_variableModal.md)
  : produces remove variable confirmation modal
